summary: Retrospective closure of a completed historical pipeline. Recomputed the original comparator from calibration selections and all evaluation reports; it exactly matches the stored rejected result. Three 122880-transition trials completed, with finite metrics and no recorded recovery. All 216 final trained evaluation episodes had zero completions, so the predeclared acceptance gate failed. Source has 72 separately checked comparison episodes. This is a historical conclusion under the old controls, not new gameplay or normal-start evidence.
